question: Are lunar day, asterism and fasting prescribed?
premises: no tithi, no naksatra, no fasting is prescribed
devoted to worldly dharma, one succeeds
inference: Calendrics and fasting waived; worldly-life plus remembrance suffices.
plain_english: No lunar day, no asterism, no fasting is prescribed — devoted to worldly dharma, one succeeds always by remembrance indeed.
